paper_title: MADLLM Multivariate Anomaly Detection via Pre-trained LLMs
caption: : (a) The impact of hyperparameter N on F1 score. (b) The impact of hyperparameter N on AUC.
model_annotation: This line plot illustrates the impact of the hyperparameter N on the AUC (%) metric. The x-axis is labeled "N" and uses a linear scale with values ranging from 0 to 20, featuring numeric tick marks spaced at intervals of 5. The y-axis is labeled "AUC (%)", indicating percentage units, and employs a linear scale ranging from 75 to 100 with tick labels positioned at intervals of 5. The plot contains five distinct data series, all represented by solid lines with different markers. The blue line with open circle markers begins at an N value of 1 with an AUC of approximately 94%, rises to roughly 98.5% at N=5, remains steady at N=10, and then gradually declines to roughly 94% at N=20. The red line with open square markers starts at approximately 87% at N=1, rises to peak near 98.5% at N=10, and then declines to end at about 91% at N=20. The orange line with open diamond markers starts near 84% at N=1, rises sharply to about 93% at N=5, continues to gradually increase to a peak near 95% at N=15, and finishes at approximately 94.5% at N=20. The green line with open star markers begins at roughly 86.5% at N=1, rises steadily to reach a peak of about 94.5% at N=15, and decreases to end at roughly 92.5% at N=20. Finally, the purple line with open downward-pointing triangle markers starts at roughly 79.5% at N=1, dips slightly to approximately 79% at N=5, surges to a peak of about 96.5% at N=10, and then drops sharply to finish at about 82.5% at N=20.
